name: W. A. Van Brunt
role: Wisconsin cattle company president visiting for the round-up
bio: W. A. Van Brunt of Wisconsin came out in May 1885 to spend about six weeks on the round-up and left pleased with his cattle. The paper calls him president of both the Badger cattle company and the VI cattle company.

moments.label: Left after six weeks on the round-up
